title: Sandy Shenanigans | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set within the gated La Valencia community on the coveted west end of Panama City Beach, this three story villa offers a refined coastal retreat with private beach access and sweeping Gulf views. Positioned between the quiet charm of the west end and the energy of Pier Park and 30A, the home balances seclusion with convenience, creating an ideal setting for both relaxation and exploration. Spanning 2,400 square feet, the residence welcomes guests with a layout designed for ease, complete with four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and the added luxury of an in home elevator. The home unfolds across three thoughtfully arranged levels, each designed with its own sense of purpose. The first floor offers a quiet, private entry point with a queen bedroom, full bath, and direct access to a back patio with a grill, creating a natural space for morning coffee or relaxed evenings outdoors. The second level is centered around rest and retreat, featuring a primary suite with a king bed and a spacious ensuite bath with soaking tub and separate shower, alongside an additional queen bedroom with access to a full hall bath.

Features: Balcony Patio Community pool Outdoor grill
Elevator use is an additional fee.
